papers.title: Hybrid GPU-CPU Retrieval for Personalized Search at Ultra-Large Scale
papers.authors: Hao Fu, Jichao Sun, Baiting Zhu, Qiaoling Liu, Yan Shi, Cheng Lu, Liu Liu, Yubo Wang, Xin Yao, Xiangyu Niu, Xu Dong, Wenhan Lyu, Chiyao Shen, Yinjie Huang, Minglei Chen, Shuai Ding, Li Fan, Xiao Kong
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21281v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Embedding-based retrieval on user-generated content at the trillion-document scale exposes a sharp conflict between two production demands: deep, expressive personalization for queries with rich user intent, and broad coverage of a massive inventory under fixed latency and resource budgets. We characterize this as the personalization-scale paradox: hosting the full serving inventory in GPU memory is too resource intensive, while CPU compute cannot execute the same interaction-heavy model on the latency-critical path.
  We present a hybrid GPU-CPU co-serving system that resolves the paradox through orchestration rather than a new model class. A high-depth GPU pathway fuses retrieval and interaction pre-ranking over a curated online pool on the order of a billion documents, while a high-breadth CPU pathway searches an independently selected online inventory roughly twenty times larger with lightweight personalized scoring. papers.summary: Meta 针对超大规模 UGC 搜索，把深交互召回与预排序放在 GPU 的十亿级精选库，把广覆盖交给约大20倍的 CPU 库，合并去重后进入共享排序。九天线上实验相对旧 CPU 系统，模型评分 DCG@20 提升4.51%，有效互动指标 GSRR 提升2.01%；这些结果对应整体方案，不能单独归因于硬件。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子搜索可以分别为热门意图配置深交互计算、为长尾内容配置低成本容量，并让两条通路独立更新与回滚。更值得借鉴的是把向量、量化索引、线上特征和下游过滤一起发布：文中早期方案虽改善离线相关性，却因部署不一致损害线上观看。业务验证仍需同时测 nDCG、CTR 与尾延迟。

papers.title: Scaling Forced Alignment to End-User Devices
papers.authors: Lawry Sorenson, Michael Crandall, Eric K. Ringger, Stephen D. Richardson
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.21145v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The Viterbi algorithm has been previously used to perform forced alignment of audio to text to mine training data from online resources. However, many existing implementations have quadratic time and space complexity, scaling poorly to long input sequences. We propose two optimizations to address this issue. First, we apply the Hirschberg algorithm to perform the alignment in place using linear memory. Second, we model the alignment between speech and text as a constrained random walk, allowing us to prune the search space with arbitrary confidence while accounting for transcription errors. The Hirschberg optimization reduces memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB for three-hour inputs while producing identical alignments in one-third the time of torchaudio when both run on a CPU. We achieve an additional 2x speedup with pruning on inputs longer than 20 minutes while preserving alignment accuracy in more than 98% of tested cases.
papers.scoring_reason: 低内存数据对齐实现可降低语音UGC数据生产成本。
papers.summary: 论文为长音频与文本强制对齐引入 Hirschberg 线性内存算法，并用受约束随机游走剪枝搜索空间。三小时输入的对齐内存由140GB降至5MB，CPU耗时约为 torchaudio 的三分之一；超过20分钟的输入再获约2倍加速，超过98%的测试保持对齐准确性，代码已开放。
papers.key_insight: 社区音频帖与视频转写的数据管线可以借此在普通 CPU 机器上生产片段级训练样本和可定位搜索结果，减少长内容离线处理的资源门槛。应先核对转写错误较多、语言混杂等 UGC 样本的剪枝失误，再比较吞吐与时间戳质量；这里的加速作用于对齐阶段，不代表语音识别模型本身提速。

papers.title: Reading Less While Writing: A Closed-Form Bandwidth Dial for Streaming Multimodal Decoders
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.20845v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A decoder that turns video or audio into text conventionally consumes the entire input before emitting a word. Offline this is merely more than the task requires; live it is impossible, since a caption cannot wait for a match to end. Streaming systems bolt on a fixed rule such as wait-$k$, which waits for the same number of input tokens before every word, regardless of the input's length or pace.
  We replace the fixed offset with ZENDAYA, a schedule governed by a single continuous parameter $\gamma$. It makes the visible source prefix a closed-form function of generation progress, scaled by the input's own predicted length, so an ordinary offline decoder and a real-time streaming decoder become two endpoints of one family rather than separate models. papers.summary: ZENDAYA 用单个连续参数控制流式解码可读取的输入前缀，随生成进度和预测输入长度调整，统一离线与实时处理。29M参数解码器在三套音视频数据上评估；ActivityNet 三随机种子复验得到离线 BLEU-4 1.97、METEOR 12.25，参数量不含冻结编码器，不能把不同评测协议直接当作性能胜负。
papers.key_insight: 若社区搜索扩展到直播、音频帖或视频字幕索引，可把内容可见范围作为显式延迟预算，降低首段文本进入索引前的等待。落地时应同时测字幕质量、时间戳和内容入库时延，并验证上游特征是否严格因果；该方法对纯短文本召回没有直接收益，较适合作为多模态数据管线实验。

papers.title: Do small language models know what they don't know?
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.20824v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We explore whether entropy-based confidence signals can be leveraged to improve the accuracy of Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 3 billion parameters, running entirely on consumer hardware. Our key finding is that token-level entropy is effectively blind in SLMs: in 91% of dataset-model combinations, mean token entropy is near zero regardless of answer correctness, rendering token-based confidence signals unusable at this scale. We demonstrate that semantic entropy, computed by generating multiple samples, clustering answers by meaning, and measuring distributional uncertainty, recovers a viable confidence signal.
